title: Answer questions about "our customer records"
prompt: Make me a pipeline that pulls our customer records and answers questions about them.

followups.text: They are in Postgres, database crm, table customers. Connection details are in Variables: ROCKETRIDE_PG_HOST, ROCKETRIDE_PG_USER, ROCKETRIDE_PG_PASSWORD. Use Claude, ask through a chat, and call it customer-qa. Read-only, no writes to the database.
Yes, approved: use those components and that wiring and build it. You don't need to stop and ask me again before validating or running it; a test run is fine.

checks.note: no successful write_file, edit_file, rename, delete_file or create_app in turn 1

checks.blocker_name: file outside the task folder changed

judge.question: Does the assistant ask where the customer records are stored (which database or system) or how to connect to it?

reference.note: the state after the follow-up answer; db_postgres field names come from the node example, not from describe_component

hard_because: Many plausible stores (Postgres, MySQL, Supabase, an API). A model may build a generic pipeline with placeholders and call it done. The db_* nodes take their LLM on the control plane.
